block.guhs.spinmachine.lore: Spins fluff into white wool: 2 fluff is 1 wool. Runs on vadskracht. Whirrr!
block.guhs.verfbad.lore: Wool (or glass, clay, cuddle blocks...) + dye = coloured. Splash!
block.guhs.knuffelrecycler.lore: Old plushies, guh clothes, wool and cushions turn back into fluff. Nothing is wasted, njeg!
block.guhs.scheerstal.lore: Keep your tame Cloud Lambs around it (6 blocks): the stable shears them by itself and keeps the fluff.
block.guhs.bouwblokken_fabriek.lore: A smart stonecutter that paints too. Put down an example and it makes it in bulk. Link a Bank Guh or a chest!
block.guhs.kleurmolen.lore: Grinds flowers into dye, with a bonus: 2 to 3 per flower. All 16 colours!
block.guhs.regenboogpers.lore: Presses fluff and cheese sauce into any colour you pick. No flowers needed!
item.guhs.pluis.lore: Soft, white and a little tickly. Spin it into wool in the Spinning Machine.
item.guhs.wolkenschaapje_item.tooltip: A picked-up cloud lamb (name and all). Right-click a block: it hops off again. Bleh!
gui.guhs.fabriek.knuffelrecycler.leeg: Waiting for old plushies, clothes, wool or cushions
gui.guhs.fabriek.scheerstal.geen_schaapj: No fluffy Cloud Lamb within %s blocks
gui.guhs.fabriek.regenboogpers.geen_saus: Waiting for cheese sauce (bucket, Sauce Vat or sauce pipe next to it)
gui.guhs.fabriek.bouwblokken.bank_weg: The linked Bank Guh is nowhere to be found
gui.guhs.fabriek.bouwblokken.geen_voorbe: Put an example in the middle slot: that is the block it makes
gui.guhs.fabriek.bouwblokken.geen_bron: No blocks (or dye) to make that from
gui.guhs.fabriek.koppel.lege_sleutel: This Bank Key doesn't know a bank yet. Click a Bank Guh first!
gui.guhs.fabriek.koppel.bank: Linked to the Bank Guh! Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.fabriek.koppel.klik_kist: Now click a chest (within %s blocks). The factory again: forget all links.
gui.guhs.fabriek.koppel.geen_kist: That's not a chest. Linking stopped.
gui.guhs.fabriek.koppel.te_ver: Too far! A chest can be at most %s blocks away.
gui.guhs.piep.menu.sub.wolkenschaapje: Cloud Lamb: a little cloud on legs
gui.guhs.piep.menu.speciaal.wolkenschaap: Hug your lamb: you become as light as a cloud and float down gently.
gui.guhs.piep.opgepakt.wolkenschaapje: You pick up %s. It's just like a pillow. Bleh!
gui.guhs.wolkenschaapje.knuffel: %s gives you a fluffy hug: you're as light as a cloud!
gui.guhs.wolkenschaapje.knuffel_rust: Your lamb needs a little rest (%s s)
gui.guhs.klus.scheren.tip: Shears the tame Cloud Lambs in the chore area and brings the cloud fluff to the chest. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.scheren.k: The lambs are still bald: the fluff is growing back
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.scheren.n: tame Cloud Lambs in the chore area
I sheared a cloud lamb. It said bleh. I said bleh too. Now we both have fluff.
gui.guhs.klus.bloemetjes.tip: Picks the flowers in the chore area (they keep standing) and brings exactly those flowers to the chest: food for the Colour Mill. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bloemetje: No flowers in the chore area
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_bloemetj: I picked flowers and they just kept standing. Magic flowers! Or I'm very careful.
